claims: Memorial Day is a federal holiday in the United States
Memorial Day is observed on the last Monday in May
Memorial Day is observed to honor military personnel who died in service
In 2026, Memorial Day is on Monday, May 25
Memorial Day marks the unofficial start of summer
Memorial Day in 2027 is on May 31
Memorial Day in 2028 is on May 29
Memorial Day in 2029 is on May 28
Memorial Day was originally known as Decoration Day
Memorial Day was established to decorate the graves of Civil War soldiers
Flags are flown at half-staff until noon on Memorial Day
Congress passed the Uniform Monday Holiday Act in 1968
The Uniform Monday Holiday Act moved Memorial Day from May 30 to the last Monday in May to create a three-day weekend
